inspection.accept.empty: The reason in accept is empty. Write why it is as designed (accept: false takes the mark off)
inspection.accept.needed: Write the reason it is as designed in value's accept (accept: false takes the mark off)
inspection.accept.notTrue: accept: true cannot be written. Write why it is as designed as a sentence (accept: false takes the mark off)
inspection.accept.shape: accept is a sentence of the reason, or false ({other} was given)
inspection.group.ambiguousPointers.fix: Write when or discriminatedBy on the line so that exactly one candidate is chosen
inspection.group.ambiguousPointers.label: Ambiguous pointers
inspection.group.brokenPaths.fix: Rewrite the path to where its target is now, or create the target (for something renamed or moved, use its new path)
inspection.group.brokenPaths.label: Broken paths
inspection.group.cardProblems.fix: Fix the values as problem says (the kind definition is in kind_read, the data shape in that shape's card)
inspection.group.cardProblems.label: Cards that do not fit their kind or data shape
inspection.group.codeChanged.fix: Compare the card with the code; fix whichever is wrong, then clear the mark with card_action's op: reviewed
inspection.group.codeChanged.label: Implementation changed since reviewed
inspection.group.flowProblems.fix: Add the node or line problem names (how to write it: guide with about: flow)
inspection.group.flowProblems.label: Flow problems
inspection.group.freeCards.fix: Once their place is decided, move them to a section that fits their kind
inspection.group.freeCards.label: Cards in free sections
inspection.group.lineProblems.fix: Change the line's kind or target so it fits the from and to of the kind definition (kind_read)
inspection.group.lineProblems.label: Lines that do not fit their kind
inspection.group.missingFolders.fix: Move the note to a folder that is there (section in card_update's value). If the folder was renamed, to the folder of the new name
inspection.group.missingFolders.label: Notes in missing folders
inspection.group.overlaps.fix: Pull them together with tidy in section_update's value, or move them to moveTo
inspection.group.overlaps.label: Overlaps in the diagram
inspection.group.peerMismatches.fix: Write the receiving (sending) end in the peer's flow, or redraw the peer line to the right peer, or remove it
inspection.group.peerMismatches.label: Mismatched exchanges between flows
inspection.group.review.fix: Bring the part in line with the cards it is connected to, or if it already is, clear the mark with card_action's op: reviewed
inspection.group.review.label: Parts to review
inspection.group.sectionProblems.fix: Move the card to a section that can hold its kind
inspection.group.sectionProblems.label: Cards that do not fit their section
inspection.group.strayFields.fix: Remove them with strayFields in card_update's value if they are not needed, or add the field to the kind definition if they are
inspection.group.strayFields.label: Values of fields the definition does not have
inspection.group.tagGroupViolations.fix: Keep only one tag of an exclusive tag group
inspection.group.uncheckedPatterns.fix: Rewrite the pattern in a form the core's regular expressions (Rust's regex) can read
inspection.group.uncheckedPatterns.label: Patterns that cannot be checked
inspection.group.unreferenced.fix: Point to it with a line or [[path]] from where it is used, or delete it if it is not needed
inspection.group.unreferenced.label: Not referenced from anywhere
inspection.group.unresolvedPointers.fix: Create a card the by value can choose as a candidate, or fix the line's target
inspection.ids.needed: Give item ids as target (the ids of inspection_list's items)
inspection.ids.notFound: {id} is not found (it was fixed, or is an item of another tree. Read inspection_list again)
inspection.ids.notFoundHint: An id not found was fixed, or is an item of another tree (read inspection_list again)
inspection.list.groupShape: group is a group's name, or a list of them
inspection.list.inShape: in is the path of a section or a card
inspection.list.noGroup: There is no group {unknown}. There are: {groups}
inspection.list.showOneOf: show is one of fix, info, accepted, all ({other} was given)
inspection.problem.ambiguousPointer: There are {count} candidates and nothing to choose by (when, discriminatedBy)
inspection.problem.codeChanged: The code its implementation lines reach ({lines}) changed after it was recorded
inspection.problem.freeCard: It is left in the free section {section}
inspection.problem.planned: {path} of {via} is not there yet (planned on the branch of goal {goal})
inspection.problem.review: {cards}, connected to it, changed after the part last did
inspection.problem.strayFields: There are values of fields the definition does not have: {fields}
inspection.problem.tagGroupViolation: {count} tags of the exclusive tag group {group} are on it
inspection.problem.unresolvedPointer: No candidate can be chosen by {by}
inspection.read.noValue: "{key}" cannot be written in inspection_read's value (it takes no value)
inspection.unmark.none: {id} has no mark (read the marked items with show: accepted in inspection_list's value)
